title: Battery Pack Check
description: Guide a quick DC battery pack inspection with unloaded and loaded voltage captures.

steps.title: Confirm Meter Mode
steps.instruction: Set the meter to DC voltage and verify the probe polarity before touching the pack.
steps.note_prompt: Record any setup notes or pack labeling.

steps.title: Measure Total Pack Voltage
steps.instruction: Measure the pack at rest and capture the total DC voltage reading.

steps.title: Measure Loaded Voltage
steps.instruction: Apply the normal load and capture the pack voltage again to observe sag.

steps.title: Record Observations
steps.instruction: Note whether the pack remained stable or showed signs of a weak cell group.
